Devin Night Pack 207: Vaults Lvl 1

Crack open a vaunted vault of viscous villains with this carefully curated selection of foes! 22 dungeon dwellers await your orders, be it massive bloat flies, scurrying skeletons, or flaming skinless specters this pack has new and horrific surprises for your next delve into the dungeon depths! Combine these familiar foes with the many minions of the another vault and bask in the cries of consternation from your hapless heroes!
